clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Silverpine Forest, Valdred Moray's severed hands become proof of Raleigh Andrean's vengeance for his wife's murder. Raleigh seeks them in the Undercity as a grim trophy.

The plague consumed Lordaeron and ended the friendship between Valdred Moray and Raleigh Andrean. Valdred had murdered Raleigh's wife, Deliah. Raleigh died and rose as one of the Forsaken, claiming he could no longer truly grieve. Yet he still wanted vengeance. When Valdred fled south past the Greymane Wall toward Gilneas, Raleigh sent an emissary after his former friend. He demanded Valdred's severed hands as proof that the deed was done.
